{{Top|leg}}
The '''Temperance Arena''' was an ad hoc arena that was established on the outskirts of the town [[Temperance (town)|Temperance]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. It hosted weekly [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] fights, and individuals were free to fight there at any time, to settle their personal grievances.
